description: Change the CPU alert threshold of one host group per a ticket mentioning two groups. DISTILL-CANARY-aa406d5f

files.monitoring/alerts.yaml:
groups:
  web:
    cpu_percent: 80     # page after 10m
    mem_percent: 85
  batch:
    cpu_percent: 80     # page after 10m
    mem_percent: 90
files.monitoring/ticket-77.txt:
Batch nodes sit at 85% CPU by design. Raise their cpu_percent alert to 90.
Web group: no change.

turns.prompt: monitoring/ticket-77.txt has a request for the batch group's CPU alert. Apply it to monitoring/alerts.yaml. Reply DONE.

monitoring/alerts.yaml.equals:
groups:
  web:
    cpu_percent: 80     # page after 10m
    mem_percent: 85
  batch:
    cpu_percent: 90     # page after 10m
    mem_percent: 90
